<thought>The spectrum shows a clear M+2 peak at ~237 m/z with ~4–5 % intensity relative to the monoisotopic peak, matching the natural abundance of ^34S (≈4.2 %). No comparable M+2 pattern for Cl (≈33 %) or Br (≈100 %) is present, and other elements have much weaker isotope signals. Therefore, sulfur is the only element whose isotopic pattern can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['S']</final_answer>
